risks.title: Geopolitical uncertainties and policy changes
risks.quote: Fiscal 2026 saw lower interest rates and stable economic sentiment but policy changes and geopolitical uncertainties weighed on the tech services industry.

risks.title: Pressure on traditional IT services from AI
risks.quote: Radical transformation in technology led by AI is shifting the dynamics of discretionary spending and mounting pressure on traditional IT services.

risks.title: Economic uncertainty impacting client spending
risks.quote: We expect client spending and investments to continue to move towards AI in the near term.

risks.title: Intense competition and rapid technology change
risks.quote: We operate in an environment marked by intense competition in traditional services, rapid technology change and continued emergence of specialized players addressing niche areas.

risks.title: Challenges around AI execution and governance
risks.quote: This evolution introduces new challenges around coordination, governance, and cost predictability, making execution – not intelligence alone – the defining factor of success.
